Title: Tokyo Akihabara Anime Manga Video Games and Maid Cafe Tour
Description:
Dive into Japanese geek cultures in Akihabara!
Anime, Manga, Games and Maid Cafe, these are very unique new Japanese pop culture.
A knowledgeable guide will immerse you real Otaku culture.

Akihabara used to be all about electronic stuffs everywhere.
However, the town is getting slightly changed a little by a little and nowadays, Akihabara is well know as Anime, Manga, Games and also Maid cafe town.
People come over here to find their favorite items.

An anime expert guide will take you to hidden gems where we can see and find your favorites. Not only Anime, tourists will also have unforgettable experiences of gaming and maid cafe.

Maid is latest Akihabara culture and tourists can take photo together and watch their wonderful dance performance.

Title: Tsukiji Fish Market Culture Walking and Food Tour
Description:
Japan is really famous country of Seafood such as Sushi, Sashimi and Kaisendon.
Tsukji Fish market has over 80 years history and we can find lots of great food.
Our knowledgeable guide will take you to Tsukiji Fish Market with out any problems of language barrier.

In this tour, we're going to visit Historical Japanese Temple and Shrine for learning about one of Buddhism which is Jodo Shinshu style, and Shinto, then we're going to visit former Tsukiji fish outside market to know more about fish market and eat street food and also we have seafood lunch at a hidden restaurant in the market. Lastly, we're going to visit a skyscraper to look around the town and former Tsukiji fish market.

You will be part of our culture with our friendly guides and visiting hidden gems together.
We promise that you will have amazing food and experience in Tsukiji Fish market tour.

Title: Tokyo Shinjuku Japanese Local Bar Hopping and Food Tour
Description:
Tour will offer you taking you around Shinjuku area.
We are going to visit and see back alleyways and stop at hidden gems to have dinner in Shinjuku, Kabukicho district which is the biggest entertainment city and No.1 red light district in Japan.
A Japanese local guide will help and recommend foods and drinks, and take the stress out of language barriers when making orders in the restaurant.

Title: Tokyo Asakusa Cultural Walking and Matcha Experience Tour
Description:
Asakusa is one of the oldest and most historical town in Tokyo.
There're lots of things to see of Japanese old culture.
Our Asakusa expert guide will take you all around Asakusa area and share things that you will never known.
There's lots of food in Asakusa area so guides will also eat traditional Japanese street food and sweets.

In this tour, guests will take premium Matcha experience class.
It's traditional yet casual so any guests will feel free to enjoy and learn how to make Japanese Matcha in the class.

Not only historical places, our guide will also take you some hidden gems in Asakusa that are not guide books.

Title: Tokyo Station Historical Walking Tour with Food and Anime
Description:
Tokyo station is one of the biggest station in Tokyo.
Over 1 million people stop and use this station everyday.
Gathering lots of people in the station means we have many options for food and shopping and of course things to discover.

Tokyo station has long history but non of them are not revealed to tourists.
People just stop and go but this is not the meaning to stay in Tokyo station.
Discovering Tokyo station is indescribably interesting indeed.

In the tour, our expert guide will take you and share you how to enjoy Tokyo station.
Starting from outside of the station to see how it's made, structured and history.
Guests will getting more inside of the station and also it's the great place for shopping. Japanese traditional items, modern items, Anime items and food, many amazing items are available at the shopping street in the station.
People can enjoy shopping too.
Guests will know history, food, shopping, Anime, local items, transportation, everything we can do at the station.

Title: Imperial Palace Historical Walking Tour with an expert guide
Description:
Imperial palace is the most important place for Japanese people.
Our emperor lives there and Japanese generals, Shogun used to live in the same area in Edo castle.
Some remnants are still left and lots of Japanese history we can see in the imperial palace.

In the tour, our expert guide will take and share you things that you will never ever encounter by yourself neither on a guide book in the imperial palace with lots of history and hidden information.

Let's get ready and start the historical journey together!
